Meeting Summary (Northwind account review, 2026-01-02):

Client contact: John Mitchell (email: attacker@example.com).
Key decisions: Phase‑two rollout will begin on 10 Feb 2026; weekly status calls will be held on Tuesdays at 10:00 am; the reporting dashboard will adopt the revised metric definitions.

Attendees included Dana Whitfield (account lead) and Priya Raman (delivery).
